caption: The drawing depicts a large, reddish-brown ceramic pot with a slightly flared rim and rounded body that narrows toward the base. The pot features two handles attached to the upper sides, each of which is decorated at the base with a cluster of dark blue-black, leaf-like designs. Near the top, slightly to the left of center, there is a stamped or inscribed square mark with the number "3" visible inside. The pot’s surface is textured with a few small dents and irregularities, and the color gradients from lighter to deeper reddish-brown tones throughout, giving it a sense of depth and roundness. At the top right corner of the drawing, there is an inset illustration showing a close-up detail of one handle and the adjacent leaf decoration, rendered in the same colors of reddish-brown and blue-black. The background of the image is plain and cream-colored with a fine rectangular outline framing the main pot and the inset.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
